title: Phantom Blade Zero Locations - Every Region, Map Order & Bosses
description: Phantom Blade Zero's regions in order, from Weeping Creek Valley to Mount Soulrend: how many story and optional bosses sit in each, what the bell network connects, and why it is wide-linear rather than open world.
keyword: phantom blade zero locations, phantom blade zero map, phantom blade zero regions, Pang Town, phantom blade world map, phantom blade zero regions in order, phantom blade zero how many areas, phantom blade zero wide linear

facts.label: World structure
facts.value: Wide-linear: handcrafted regions joined seamlessly, not an open world

facts.label: Hand-painted maps
facts.value: Eight, in Chinese ink-wash style, deliberately imprecise

facts.label: Named regions
facts.value: 6 so far, from official and community material

facts.label: Setting names
facts.value: The Wulin 武林, also called the Phantom World in official English copy

facts.label: Full map
facts.value: The game has no world map screen; regions are tabulated below

sections.title: Not an open world, not a corridor either
sections.content:
This is one of the most-asked questions about the game, and the answer is settled. S-GAME's own wording: Phantom Blade Zero is not an open-world game, nor a linear adventure from beginning to end - every corner is handcrafted. Community documentation describes it as a wide-linear flow built from large maps with light Metroidvania-style exploration and side content filling them.

Navigation runs through eight hand-painted Chinese ink-wash maps. In complex regions they deliberately give only a rough sense of direction, which is where the hidden enemies, side quests, rare treasures and story clues sit. Previewers reported genuinely struggling to orient early on, so that friction is designed, not a shortcoming.

sections.title: The named regions
sections.content:
• 溪谷 / the Valley - the first map, where Soul wakes.
  • 血色森林 / Blood-Coloured Forest - a forest under red blood-mist.
  • 庞镇 / Pang Town - the central hub, where martial artists from across the Wulin have gathered; described in the deep dive as a trap of rival factions and hidden malice, and scored with an unusual seven-beat piece.
  • 梅谷湖 / Plum Valley Lake - a lake area crossed by water travel on a fast vessel.
  • 狱山 / Prison Mountain - a mountain prison region.
  • 正道大营 / Camp of the Righteous Path - the encampment of a righteous sect.

Also named in official material: an abandoned warehouse hung with puppets where a ritual is underway, and a steam-powered iron tower built for some kind of dark experiment.

sections.title: Every region, and what is actually in it
sections.content:
Region names are the ones the boss data uses, which is also how the walkthrough and the boss pages are grouped. Counts are encounters, not characters - a region with eight optional fights does not mean eight strangers standing around.

RegionStory bossesOptionalYou will meet

Pangzhen65Blaze, Shadow Warden Captain (鬼差队长 火流星), Cavalrybane (鬼差高手 斩骑), Wu Xuan, the Fallen General (堕落将军 武轩) and 8 more
Mandate Encampment42Corpse-Eating Xue, Wan Jun, the Coppermaul, Red, the Mysterious Wraith and 3 more

Mountain of Imprisonment42Iron Butcher, Bi Feng, Giant Saber Commander (巨刀统领 白峰), Kui Yanyan and 3 more

The imbalance is the point. Pangzhen carries 11 encounters because it is the hub players return to, while Mirage Estate carries 3 and is over almost before it starts.

sections.title: The order you pass through them
sections.content:
The regions are sequential, with light backtracking through bells rather than free travel across the whole map. Numbering below follows the boss order, so you can tell at a glance how much of the game is still ahead.

Boss #RegionWhat this block is for
1–7Prologue & Weeping Creek ValleyTutorial ground. The first duel teaches parry timing and cannot be lost.
8–15Crimson Manor & Crimson ForestFirst real difficulty step. Two acolytes and a secret boss hide here.
16–22Village of LuPuppet-heavy. The well drops you into a story fight you cannot walk past.
23–33PangzhenThe hub. Most optional fights in the game branch off its bells.
34–39Mandate EncampmentStory-dense, almost no optional content.
40–45Meigu LakeOptional-heavy. One fight here gates the true ending.
46–51Mountain of ImprisonmentStory run with two shrine fights tucked in.
52–54Mirage EstateShort block, two story bosses and one optional.
55–60Mount Soulrend & endgamePoint of no return. Optional fights left undone expire on the climb.

Mount Soulrend is the point of no return - the ascent locks out optional content behind you, which matters more for region completion percentage than for the story itself. See the full boss order for the encounter-by-encounter list.

sections.title: Two official names for the same world
sections.content:
Expect to see both. The August State of Play post on PlayStation Blog, written by S-GAME's founder, calls the setting the Wulin (武林). The English store copy and the Japanese product page call it the Phantom World - and the Chinese site uses 影境. None of these is a translation error; they are the marketing, the in-fiction and the localised names for one place.

Japanese material uses 武林 alongside Phantom World, and the Chinese official site's own tagline pairs 影境江湖 with 功夫朋克 (kungfupunk).

sections.title: Getting around
sections.content:
Bells handle fast travel between discovered locations, and each bell also clears nearby minimap fog and restocks combat resources. Water travel exists in at least one region. Some areas are only reachable once you hold the right Phantom Edge, which is why per-map completion percentages matter more here than in a typical action game.

Region design is said to draw on real terrain from Guangdong, Fujian, Zhejiang and Hebei, with Ming-era architecture sitting alongside industrial machinery - the visual argument for the kungfupunk label.

Community terminology and structure on this page comes from the 影之刃 WIKI on BWIKI, a fan wiki maintained by the moderators of the 影之刃 Baidu Tieba, which states it has no affiliation with S-GAME. It was last edited 2026-10-13 and much of it is still marked 待补充 (to be filled in). Anything taken from it is labelled as community-sourced rather than official, and counts will be replaced with measured data after release.
